notes: Covers the R-320DK, R-320DQ and R-320DW.

method: Sharp R-320DK service manual (manualslib copy, which also covers R-320DQ and R-320DW), electric parts list: power transformer, HV capacitor, fan motor and turntable motor with part numbers.
Rows were matched by position in the extracted page text, so check the printed page before ordering.

comps.spec: Power transformer, part RTRN-A603WRZZ (parts list ref 1-14)
High voltage capacitor, part RC-QZA234WRE0 (parts list ref 1-7)
Fan motor, part RMOTEA383WRE0 (parts list ref 1-9). Interchangeable alternate RMOTEA355WRE0 is also listed.
Turntable motor, part RMOTDA229WRE0 (parts list ref 1-12). Interchangeable alternate RMOTDA211WRE0 is also listed.

sources.title: Sharp R-320DK service manual, electric parts list (manualslib, page 2)
